biggest_catch: Rate is stated as 'starting at' $5 per 15 minutes - higher-paying studies are not guaranteed; exact per-study amounts are set by each study.
catches: Stated rate is a floor ('starting at') - individual studies set their own exact amounts
Most studies are in Los Angeles (on-campus or local) - online studies vary by study
Must be 18+ and fluent in English
Compensation is per completed study; frequency of available studies varies
Separate pools exist (course-credit pools for BUAD 304/307/MOR 497) - make sure to join the compensated pool, not the credit pool
